# Samadhan

> Civic-tech prototype for AI-assisted constituency development planning. It turns multilingual citizen requests into structured, evidence-backed project recommendations for human review. Not an emergency service or automatic government decision system.

- [Home](https://samadhan-chi.vercel.app/)
- [How it works](https://samadhan-chi.vercel.app/how-it-works)
- [Methodology](https://samadhan-chi.vercel.app/methodology)
- [FAQs](https://samadhan-chi.vercel.app/faq)
- [Report an issue](https://samadhan-chi.vercel.app/report-issue)

Priority formula: 40% demand + 40% infrastructure deficit + 20% severity. Officials retain final authority. Do not treat illustrative counts or mock datasets as observed results.
